title: Course Recording Access
content: Students enrolled in a course can access lecture recordings from the course dashboard. If recordings are missing, verify that the student is enrolled in the correct course and batch. Recording access may take some time after a live lecture is completed.

title: Duplicate Payment
content: If a student appears to have been charged more than once for the same course, the payment transaction must be reviewed before a refund or reversal is confirmed. Students should provide the transaction reference or payment receipt when contacting support.

title: Course Refund Policy
content: Refund requests are handled according to the applicable course refund policy. Support should verify the purchase, payment transaction, and refund eligibility before confirming whether a refund can be issued.

title: Account Password Reset
content: Students who cannot access their account should use the password reset option on the login page. If the reset email is not received, verify the registered email address and check the spam or junk folder.

title: Batch Access
content: Students must be assigned to the correct batch to access batch-specific classes, schedules, recordings, and resources. If the expected batch is not visible, support should verify the student's enrollment and batch assignment.

title: Technical LMS Issues
content: For LMS problems such as pages not loading, videos failing to play, or unexpected errors, students should first refresh the page, verify their internet connection, and try another browser. Persistent issues should be escalated to technical support.

title: Exam Schedule
content: Exam dates and schedules are published through the official academic communication channels. Students should check the latest official announcement for the applicable examination schedule.

title: Certificate Request
content: Certificate requests are processed after the applicable course or program requirements are completed. The exact process and eligibility depend on the relevant academic or course policy.

title: Course Enrollment Confirmation
content: After purchasing a course, the student account should reflect the enrollment associated with the transaction. If the course does not appear in the dashboard, support should verify the payment status and enrollment record.

title: Course Not Showing in Dashboard
content: If a purchased course is not visible in the dashboard, the student should log out and sign in again and verify that the correct account is being used. Support should check the enrollment record if the course remains unavailable.

title: Recording Delayed After Live Class
content: Lecture recordings may not become available immediately after a live class. A short processing period may be required before the recording is published to the course dashboard.

title: Missing Individual Lecture
content: If one lecture recording is missing while other recordings are visible, support should verify whether the lecture was recorded successfully and whether publication is still pending.

title: Wrong Course Enrollment
content: If a student has access to a different course than the one purchased, support should verify the transaction and enrollment mapping before changing course access.

title: Payment Failed
content: A failed payment does not normally create a completed course enrollment. Students should verify whether the payment was actually completed and check their bank or payment provider for the transaction status.

title: Payment Successful but Course Missing
content: When a payment is successful but the purchased course is missing, support should verify the transaction reference, payment status, and corresponding enrollment record before manually updating access.

title: Payment Pending
content: A payment marked as pending should not be treated as a completed payment until the payment provider confirms the final status. Support should avoid promising course activation or refunds while the transaction remains unresolved.

title: Payment Receipt
content: Students reporting payment problems should provide the transaction reference, payment receipt, or other transaction identifier when available. These details help support locate and verify the payment.

title: Refund Request Submission
content: A refund request should include the relevant course or product, transaction reference, purchase details, and reason for the request. Refund eligibility must be verified against the applicable policy.

title: Refund Processing Status
content: After a refund has been approved, the refund transaction may require additional processing time before the funds appear in the student's original payment method.

title: Refund Eligibility Review
content: Support should verify purchase date, transaction status, product eligibility, and any applicable refund conditions before approving or rejecting a refund request.

title: Forgotten Account Password
content: Students who forget their password should use the password reset flow associated with their registered email address. They should avoid repeatedly entering incorrect passwords if the account has temporary protection against repeated failed attempts.

title: Password Reset Email Not Received
content: If a password reset email is not received, students should check spam or junk folders and confirm that they entered the email address associated with the account. Persistent issues should be escalated to support.

title: Account Email Change
content: Requests to change the registered account email address require verification of the student's identity and account ownership. Support should not change account ownership details without completing the required verification process.

title: Locked Account
content: An account may temporarily become inaccessible after repeated unsuccessful login attempts or security checks. Students should use the normal recovery process and contact support if access cannot be restored.

title: Incorrect Batch Assignment
content: If the student is assigned to the wrong batch, support should verify the enrollment record and intended batch before making any change. Batch changes should follow the applicable enrollment rules.

title: Batch Schedule Not Visible
content: Batch schedules are available only when the student's account is correctly associated with the relevant batch. If the schedule is missing, verify the batch assignment and enrollment status.

title: Cannot Join Batch Class
content: If a student cannot join a scheduled batch class, verify the student's batch membership, class schedule, and access permissions. Technical issues with the class platform should be handled as a technical support issue.

title: Video Not Playing
content: For videos that fail to play, students should refresh the page, verify internet connectivity, disable conflicting browser extensions if applicable, and try another supported browser or device. Persistent failures should be escalated.

title: LMS Page Not Loading
content: If an LMS page does not load, students should refresh the page, check connectivity, clear temporary browser data if necessary, and try another supported browser. Repeated failures should be reported to technical support.

title: Unexpected LMS Error
content: When the LMS displays an unexpected error, the student should capture the error message or screenshot if possible and provide the affected page, course, and approximate time of occurrence to support.

title: Mobile App Access Issue
content: For issues using the mobile application, students should verify that the application is updated, restart the application, and check their network connection. Persistent application-specific issues should be escalated with device and app version details.

title: Assignment Submission Issue
content: If an assignment cannot be submitted, verify the submission deadline, file format, file size, and course access. Screenshots or error messages should be included when escalating technical submission problems.

title: Assignment Deadline
content: Assignment deadlines are determined by the applicable course or academic schedule. Students should refer to the official course announcement or assignment page for the current deadline.

title: Exam Result Information
content: Exam results are published through the designated official academic communication channels after evaluation is completed. Support should not provide unofficial result information.

title: Exam Registration
content: Students should complete exam registration according to the published academic instructions and within the specified registration period. Registration eligibility depends on the applicable academic rules.

title: General Support Escalation
content: Requests that cannot be resolved using the available support knowledge base should be escalated for human review. The escalation should include the student's issue, relevant context, attempted troubleshooting, and supporting information.

title: Multiple Issues in One Ticket
content: A ticket containing multiple independent issues should be identified as a multi-issue request. Each issue should be evaluated separately so that payment, access, technical, academic, or account concerns are not incorrectly treated as a single problem.

title: Repeated Support Contact
content: If a student reports that they have contacted support repeatedly without resolution, the issue should receive additional review. Repeated contact may indicate that the existing support response did not resolve the underlying problem.

title: Urgent Support Escalation
content: Issues involving financial transactions, account security, repeated unresolved failures, or significant access problems may require human review instead of an automatic response. The final decision should consider the issue category, available evidence, and applicable policy.

title: Unsupported Information Request
content: When a support request asks for information that is not available in the internal knowledge base, the agent should not invent an answer. The request should either use an approved external information source or be escalated for human review.
